reply.description: Your next chat message to the user, in the user's language.

nda.description: All Mutual NDA cover page fields after applying the conversation. Field values are in English. Use an empty string for anything still unknown.

purpose.description: How Confidential Information may be used.

effectiveDate.description: Effective date as yyyy-mm-dd, or empty while unknown.

mndaTerm.description: expires: the MNDA expires mndaTermYears after the Effective Date. untilTerminated: continues until terminated.

confidentialityTerm.description: years: confidentiality lasts confidentialityYears after the Effective Date. perpetual: in perpetuity.

governingLaw.description: US state whose laws govern, e.g. Delaware.

jurisdiction.description: City or county and state of the courts, e.g. courts located in New Castle, DE.

modifications.description: Modifications to the standard terms, or empty for none.

title.description: Job title of the person signing.

noticeAddress.description: Email or postal address for notices.
